<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Senzu Beans''' fully restore your health, ki and stamina in one bite. They are the classic emergency heal of DragonMineZ: keep a few on you for tough fights, saga bosses and raids.

<!--T:8-->
Besides the regular bean there are three colored beans, '''Health''', '''Ki''' and '''Stamina''', which each restore only their own resource. Unlike regular beans, you can grow them yourself.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting Senzu Beans == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
* '''Korin''' gives you '''5''' Senzu Beans once every '''15 minutes''' (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Korin|Korin]]). The service shows a live countdown while it is on cooldown.
* '''Dragon wishes:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]] grants 16 Senzu Beans and [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]] grants 32.
* '''Story quests:''' many saga quests reward Senzu Beans, for example ''Korin's Senzu Beans'' in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|Sagas]]).
* '''Raids:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Assault|Saiyan Assault]] rewards 2 and [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]] rewards 3.
* '''Crafting:''' one Health, one Ki and one Stamina Senzu Bean plus a Namek Moss make '''3''' regular Senzu Beans.
</translate>
{{Recipe|senzu_bean}}

<translate>
== Colored Senzu Beans == <!--T:11-->
</translate>

<translate>
=== Growing them === <!--T:20-->

<!--T:21-->
Each colored bean grows from its own seeds: '''Senzu Bean Seeds (Health)''', '''(Ki)''' and '''(Stamina)'''. Plant them on Farmland, like any DMZ crop (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Farming|Farming]]). A Senzu crop always drops its seeds back, plus a bean when it is fully grown.

<!--T:22-->
You can craft the seeds in two ways:

<!--T:23-->
* from a bean of that color;
* from a Namek Moss and a capsule: Green Capsule for Health seeds, Blue Capsule for Ki seeds and Yellow Capsule for Stamina seeds (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsules|Capsules]]).
</translate>
{{Recipe|senzu_bean_seeds_red|senzu_bean_seeds_blue|senzu_bean_seeds_yellow|size=small}}

<translate>
== Cooldown == <!--T:24-->

<!--T:25-->
All Senzu Beans '''share one cooldown''', 12 seconds by default, so you can't chain one bean of each color. Eating a bean from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Senzu Bag|Senzu Bag]] uses the same cooldown. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Medi-Bugs|Medi-Bug (Ant)]] has its own cooldown of the same length.
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|senzuCooldownTicks}}

<translate>
== Other uses == <!--T:26-->

<!--T:27-->
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Senzu Bag|Senzu Bag]]:''' carries up to 64 beans of any color in one slot.
* '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Heart Medicine|Heart Medicine]]:''' brew a Senzu Bean into any Potion of Regeneration.
* '''Hermit's Fern:''' 4 Namek Moss and 2 Senzu Beans make this stat plant (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Farming|Farming]]).
* The Green Capsule recipe uses a Senzu Bean (Health) (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsules|Capsules]]).
</translate>
